title: Cleanup dry run
summary: The dialog behind 'See the dry run' on DJDL's Packages page: what cleanup would delete, per package, with what it keeps and the sizes, when the deletion actually happens, and a warning about two recent installs that asked for a version that goes. The default is to keep the Oct 14 start; deleting early is a separate, explicit danger action.
compare: Opens from the cleanup callout on Packages; the page (as packages.feeds) stays dimmed behind it.

Three short lines open the body: the run's time as a meta line ('Dry run Oct 7, 09:00'), the timing in bold ('These go with the first stable release after Oct 14.'; nothing is deleted before), and 'Copies on PyPI.org stay.'

One row per package: Deletes (count of prereleases and the first and last version in mono) and Keeps (stable count plus kept prereleases with their range) add up to the Versions column on Packages (33 + 6 + 8 = 47, 2 + 4 = 6, 6 + 6 + 2 = 14). The total row says 41 deleted, 26 kept, 18.6 MB.
The kept rule is said in words under the table (every stable version, and any dev or beta newer than the latest stable), with all 41 rows as a CSV download.

When installs in the last 30 days asked for a version that goes, a warning callout names the version and the dates, tells the operator to ask plugin developers to move to 2.3.0 or 2.4.0-beta.3 before Oct 14, and offers 'Copy a notice for plugin developers'. With no such installs, the callout is absent.

The foot says exactly what each button does: 'Turn off cleanup' (ghost, left; sets release.packages.prunePrereleases off for DJDL), 'Delete these 41 versions now (18.6 MB)' as a danger outline with the trash icon, and the primary 'Keep the Oct 14 start', which closes and changes nothing. No retention field, no per-track switch.

Phone: the dialog is the kit's bottom sheet; the body scrolls with each package as one stacked block (Deletes with its range, Keeps with its range) and no sideways scroll; the buttons are pinned full width with the primary on top, as on every dialog in the area.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.
Ship builds is one identity (B5): Release cyan rule, chip, tile and nav marker, the Package glyph, crumb '<Product> › Ship builds'; no per-page green or tangerine.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: deleting early is no longer the green primary, the timing is explicit, and the numbers add up to the Packages page.

findings.issue: [Flow/safety] The filled green primary with a trash icon was 'Turn on cleanup now', nudging an irreversible deletion under a warning that two installs would break; the dialog never says when the 41 versions actually go.
findings.resolution: The primary is 'Keep the Oct 14 start' (closes, nothing changes). Deleting early is a danger-outline secondary that says what it does: 'Delete these 41 versions now (18.6 MB)', with the trash icon. A bold sentence gives the timing: 'Cleanup turns on Oct 14. These 41 versions are deleted when the next stable release ships after that. Until then, nothing is deleted.' (F-36: they go at the next stable).

findings.issue: [Data/copy] 'Keeps' reads as the complete list and the arithmetic fails against Versions on Packages; the lockfile advice addresses people who don't own those lockfiles; the opening sentence dangles; 'PyPI.org is never cleaned' is not on screen.
findings.resolution: Deletes and Keeps now carry counts and ranges that add up to Versions on Packages (source-kit 33 deleted, 6 stable and 8 prereleases kept = 47; crate-schema 2 + 4 = 6; djdl-crates 6 + 6 + 2 = 14; 41 deleted, 26 kept). The warning says 'Ask plugin developers to move to 2.3.0 or 2.4.0-beta.3 before Oct 14' with 'Copy a notice for plugin developers'. The opening reads 'The dry run on Oct 7 at 09:00 found 41 versions on DJDL's feeds that cleanup would delete. Copies on PyPI.org are never cleaned.'

findings.issue: [Visual] Close is lavender in light and borderless in dark; the area has no single phone dialog foot; on phone Keeps and Size are off-canvas.
findings.resolution: Close is gone (the X stays) and every Cancel in the area is the kit's outline button, visible in both themes. One phone foot for every dialog in the area: the kit's .sheet (ADMIN.md §Overlays), full-width buttons pinned at the bottom. Declined the 'primary last' order: ADMIN.md and the kit put the primary on top of a phone sheet. On phone each package is a stacked block with Deletes and Keeps and their ranges, no sideways scroll.

findings.issue: [Visual] The light --pk-warning-subtle fill (#eae7e6) reads as a grey, disabled box (the cleanup dry run's lockfile warning and the Play callout on Updates (Godot)).
findings.resolution: declined: --pk-warning-subtle is the brand token the kit carries verbatim from packages/brand/css; warming it in the mockup kit alone would make every mockup disagree with the built console. Flagged for the brand package (the lead's call), where one change fixes mockups and screens together.

findings.issue: The phone sheet hides the totals and the most important warning below the fold with no cue.
findings.resolution: The 'recent installs' warning is directly under the lede; the sheet is a scrolling .dialog.scroll.fade at most 90vh; lede 'Dry run Oct 7, 09:00. These go with the first stable release after Oct 14; never from PyPI.org.'; the Kept footnote is the column header 'Keeps (stable + newer)'; 'Turn off cleanup' stays a left text link with 24px before the primary (.set-apart).

findings.issue: Require a typed confirmation for 'Delete 41 versions now', add a Close button, demote 'Keep the Oct 14 start'.
findings.resolution: declined: changes flow and adds states; the button order is correct. Flagged to the lead as a product question (a missing confirm on a destructive action).
